description: MUTATES Scalingo infrastructure — creates or updates environment variables in bulk (each { name, value } is created if new or updated if it exists). This usually triggers a restart to apply the new env. Names ≤64 chars, values ≤8192 chars. Scalingo API: PUT /v1/apps/{app}/variables. Returns { variables }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

name: set_variables
title: Set environment variables (bulk)
